From 76385a665ff5cfdf0a6dda43ec9bce7e7d5387d3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Takashi Iwai <tiwai@suse.de>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2020 15:56:45 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] ASoC: bcm: Fix pointer cast warning

The NULL check can be done gracefully without cast.  It fixes a
compile warning like:
  sound/soc/bcm/bcm63xx-pcm-whistler.c:184:6: warning: cast to pointer from integer of different size [-Wint-to-pointer-cast]

Fixes: 88eb404ccc3e ("ASoC: brcm: Add DSL/PON SoC audio driver")
Signed-off-by: Takashi Iwai <tiwai@suse.de>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200330135645.9707-1-tiwai@suse.de
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>

diff --git a/sound/soc/bcm/bcm63xx-pcm-whistler.c b/sound/soc/bcm/bcm63xx-pcm-whistler.c
index e46c390683e7..b7a1efc7406e 100644
--- a/sound/soc/bcm/bcm63xx-pcm-whistler.c
+++ b/sound/soc/bcm/bcm63xx-pcm-whistler.c
@@ -181,7 +181,7 @@ bcm63xx_pcm_pointer(struct snd_soc_component *component,
 	snd_pcm_uframes_t x;
 	struct bcm63xx_runtime_data *prtd = substream->runtime->private_data;
 
-	if ((void *)prtd->dma_addr_next == NULL)
+	if (!prtd->dma_addr_next)
 		prtd->dma_addr_next = substream->runtime->dma_addr;
 
 	x = bytes_to_frames(substream->runtime,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `sound/soc/bcm/bcm63xx-pcm-whistler.c`**
- The line checking if `prtd->dma_addr_next` is `NULL` was modified. 
- The original code used a cast to `(void *)` for the comparison: 
  ```c
  if ((void *)prtd->dma_addr_next == NULL)
  ```
- This was changed to a more straightforward check without the cast:
  ```c
  if (!prtd->dma_addr_next)
  ```

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a compile warning related to pointer casting, specifically a warning about casting an integer of different size to a pointer. 
- By removing the cast and using a direct null check, the patch improves code clarity and eliminates the warning, thus enhancing the overall code quality. 
- This change is part of a fix for a previous commit identified by the hash `88eb404ccc3e`, which introduced the issue.

Fixes: 88eb404ccc3e ("ASoC: brcm: Add DSL/PON SoC audio driver")
Signed-off-by: Takashi Iwai <tiwai@suse.de>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by a pointer cast warning due to the use of a cast to `(void *)` when checking if `prtd->dma_addr_next` was `NULL`. This approach can lead to potential issues when the sizes of the integer and pointer types differ, resulting in a compile warning and possible undefined behavior. The warning indicates that the code is not handling the pointer comparison correctly, which could lead to incorrect logic in the program.

Here is the patch:
 
 static snd_pcm_uframes_t
 bcm63xx_pcm_pointer(struct snd_soc_component *component,
 		struct snd_pcm_substream *substream)
 {
 	snd_pcm_uframes_t x;
 	struct bcm63xx_runtime_data *prtd = substream->runtime->private_data;
 
-	if ((void *)prtd->dma_addr_next == NULL)
+	if (!prtd->dma_addr_next)
 		prtd->dma_addr_next = substream->runtime->dma_addr;
 
 	x = bytes_to_frames(substream->runtime,
 		prtd->dma_addr_next - substream->runtime->dma_addr);
 
 	return x == substream->runtime->buffer_size ? 0 : x;
 }
